# Real-orbital RBM input for issue #669

Byte-identical copy of `gpu/mvmc-gpu-cuda/tests/fixtures/rbm/hubbard_rbm_L16`
(PR #668), generated by `gpu/mvmc-gpu-cuda/tests/fixtures/rbm/gen_inputs.py`
(SHA-256 `732ae490b9f15e9b27c43016d3e0570ac5c58c6c0e0aa7591e974576b20dc77a`).
`inputs.sha256` lists the file hashes (`sha256sum -c inputs.sha256`). The
verbatim C 1.3.0 readers accept every RBM section (see that directory's
README). It is copied so the root-crate tests do not depend on the excluded
`gpu/` tree.

16-site doped Hubbard chain, all nine RBM sections with real coefficients and
binary-fraction `In*RBM` overlays, PairHop and Exchange.

`crates/mvmc-core/tests/issue669_real_rbm_runner.rs` edits a temporary copy:
Slater and RBM optimization flags are set to 0 (so `InitParameter` consumes the
same RNG words for real and complex orbitals), fixed `InOrbital` values and
spin-conserving `InterAll` terms are added, and `Orbital ComplexType` selects
the real or complex path. No expected values are stored: the test compares
the real run with the complex run and RBM-zeroed runs with RBM-free runs.
